precipitation.scientific_variable: IMERG liquid and frozen precipitation rates

active_fires.scientific_variable: Moving five-day window of VIIRS fire radiative power (FRP)

carbon_monoxide.scientific_variable: Near-surface carbon monoxide (CO) concentration from GEOS-CF
carbon_monoxide.source_mismatch: SVS 5115 is Global Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (CO2), not CO. The validated CO visualization is SVS 5153; only SVS 5153 supplies this category's legend.

nitrogen_oxides.scientific_variable: Near-surface nitrogen oxides (NO + NO2) concentration from GEOS-CF

near_surface_temperature.scientific_variable: Near-surface air temperature (T2M; GEOS-FP, 2 m in the detailed description)
near_surface_temperature.short_description_mismatch: The short page description says 3 m above the surface; the detailed page description and T2M legend say 2 m. The detailed value is used and the discrepancy is preserved here.
